answer: Ember-decay bond: each identity locks a 70-credit pigment-dyed bond on a public ledger. The bond is an ember cooling 7 credits an epoch unless a fresh signed receipt restokes it; auditors replay it. A pigment on two bonds, or a copied receipt, burns both; a dead ember sends a ripple that strips its weight until it relocks. Restokes cost 40, then 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 +70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool; honest agents pay 40 once.
